review_candidates.description: 1. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Cisco Network Engineer to serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise and data center networking. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on the design, implementation, operation, and troubleshooting of Cisco Nexus–based spine-leaf fabrics. The ideal candidate must possess strong technical expertise and proven ownership of complex network environments, with the ability to contribute at full capacity from day one, without an extended ramp-up period. 2. Key Responsibilities Data Center Networking: Design, build, operate, and maintain data center networks using Cisco Nexus 9000 platforms and spine-leaf architecture based on VXLAN/EVPN. Fabric Management: Manage and operate data center fabrics using Cisco Nexus Dashboard. Routing and Switching: Own routing and switching across enterprise and data center environments, from network design and implementation through complex troubleshooting and resolution. Incident Management: Lead advanced troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex network incidents beyond monitoring or NOC-level support. Campus Networking: Support campus network infrastructure, including wireless LAN controllers (WLCs), wireless access points, and 802.1X authentication. Network Automation: Develop, implement, and maintain network automation solutions using Ansible and/or Python. Secure Connectivity: Support secure network connectivity and related configurations involving TLS and IPsec. Documentation and Communication: Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate network designs, issues, solutions, and technical decisions effectively to engineering teams and business stakeholders. 3. Required Qualifications Candidates must demonstrate the following: Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus 9000 switches, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, and spine-leaf architecture using VXLAN/EVPN. Strong expertise in routing and switching across enterprise and data center environments. Proven experience in network design, implementation, advanced troubleshooting, or end-to-end technical ownership. Experience beyond monitoring and routine NOC operations, with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex network issues. Ability to function as a subject matter expert and contribute independently from day one, with minimal or no ramp-up time. 4. Preferred Qualifications 10+ years of networking experience, including hands-on Cisco technologies across enterprise and data center environments. Practical experience with campus networking, wireless LAN controllers, access points, and 802.1X authentication. Experience developing network automation solutions using Ansible and/or Python. Solid understanding of TLS and IPsec and their application in secure network connectivity. 5. Candidate Submission Requirements For every candidate submitted, please provide the following information: Cisco Platforms and Technologies: Details of Cisco platforms, technologies, architectures, and the scale and complexity of environments managed. Total Cisco Experience: Total years of Cisco-focused networking experience, highlighting relevant enterprise and data center exposure. Technical Self-Rating: A self-assessment out of 5, accompanied by a brief justification based on hands-on experience. Day-One Readiness: Explicit confirmation that the candidate can independently perform the required responsibilities from day one, without an extended ramp-up period. Communication Skills: Brief notes on communication clarity, documentation skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts and decisions. Must-Have Technical Summary: A concise, point-by-point summary demonstrating how the candidate meets each mandatory requirement, supported by specific examples of hands-on experience. 6. Candidate Evaluation Priorities Candidates will be evaluated primarily on: Hands-on expertise in Cisco Nexus 9000, Nexus Dashboard, and VXLAN/EVPN spine-leaf fabrics. Strong routing and switching fundamentals and advanced troubleshooting capabilities. Demonstrated ownership of network design, implementation, and complex issue resolution. Ability to operate independently as a senior-level subject matter expert from day one. Important: Candidates whose experience is limited primarily to network monitoring, routine operations, or NOC-level support without hands-on engineering ownership will not meet the core requirements of this role.

review_candidates.title: Lead Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)? At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security. We are seeking a mid-level systems administrator with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience to join a team doing technically demanding work on mission-critical systems that directly support our programs. You will take ownership of real problems, work across a diverse technology stack, and see the impact of your work. This is an on-site position in Palm Bay, FL, embedded within a collaborative team responsible for keeping platforms, systems, and services operational and performing as required. Rincon Research Corporation (RRC), an employee owned company, is seeking a talented, tenacious, results-driven individualto work in a multi-disciplinary R&D environment with similarly motivated electrical engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, and analysts who are collectively responsible for creating custom digital signal processing solutions and leveraging them to make an operational mission impact. Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future! What are the primary responsibilities in the Lead Systems Administrator position? In this role, you will serve as a primary point of contact for technical end user support for enterprise and air-gapped systems, working directly with users on complex, specialized systems. You will also take ownership of server and storage management, system patching and compliance, and deployment activities at both local and remote locations. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Provide technical end user support for highly specialized mission systems, diagnosing and resolving issues across hardware, software, and integrated platforms Monitor and triage systems and applications to identify issues and assess their impact on hardware, network, or service operations Manage the full lifecycle of servers, storage systems, and associated hardware, including provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and decommission Manage and maintain enterprise flash storage arrays and associated data infrastructure Deploy, configure, and maintain RF and specialized hardware systems, ensuring operational readiness Travel to remote sites to perform system deployments, upgrades, and on-site support activities Build and maintain monitoring capabilities, dashboards, and alerting to provide insight into system and service health Develop and maintain operational documentation including user guides, knowledge bases, system maintenance records, configuration standards, and repeatable deployment practices Manage system compliance and security vulnerability remediation, including tracking findings, coordinating patching cycles, and maintaining documentation to meet regulatory and program requirements Maintain lab environments in a clean, organized, and compliant state consistent with established standards Participate in capacity planning, infrastructure migrations, and technology refresh cycles, including upgrades and improvements with minimal disruption to operations Propose and implement technical solutions that support infrastructure modernization and operational continuity What required background will make you successful? Required MUST BE A US CITIZEN Active TS/SCI Security Clearance Experience with Special Access Systems Certifications Security certification in compliance with DOD 8570 required within 90 days of hire Professional certification in one or more of the following areas required within 6 months of hire RHCSA, RHCE Education and Experience A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or 5 years of equivalent hands-on experience Desired Skills Proven experience administering Linux systems (RHEL, Rocky, CentOS), including patching, remediation, compliance scanning, and security tooling such as Nessus or Rapid7 Experience managing physical and virtualized server environments alongside enterprise storage platforms, including flash arrays, SAN, NFS, iSCSI, and object storage Working knowledge of configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Terraform, and scripting experience in Bash, Python, or PowerShell Foundational knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and subnets, as well as PKI, certificate management, and related security practices Familiarity with observability practices including logging, monitoring, and telemetry across systems and applications Where is the position located? This position can be located at our Palm Bay, FL office. This position is on-site and not a hybrid role. The likely salary range for this position is $108,000 to $122,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. What benefits does RRC offer? 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD) Flexible reimbursement spending accounts for medical expense and dependent care Immediate participation and vesting in the company’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) Plan Employer contributions to RRC’s ESOP Employer matching contributions to the company’s 401( k) Plan Employer discretionary contributions to the company’s 401(k) Plan Rincon Research Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.
